decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the High Street shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 9am to 7pm Monday to Friday and 9am to 4pm Saturday.
Condition : 5 - No animals are to be left on the premises overnight.
description: Change of use from Auction Rooms to Veterinary Surgery
